primaryButtonLabel.description:
Text to be rendered at the top of the modal in the header section.
Note that if the translation value contains dynamic variables,
e.g. "Hello {name}", do not wrap the translation key with '{~' and '~}'.

closeModalOnPrimaryButtonClick.description: Whether or not to close the modal when the primary button is clicked.

primaryButtonStyle.description: The styles available for the primary button in a modal.

closeModalOnSecondaryButtonClick.description: Whether or not to close the modal when the secondary button is clicked.

secondaryButtonLabel.description: The label available for the secondary button in a modal.

secondaryButtonStyle.description: The styles available for the secondary button in a modal.

closeModalOnTertiaryButtonClick.description: Whether or not to close the modal when the tertiary button is clicked.

tertiaryButtonLabel.description: The label available for the tertiary button in a modal.

tertiaryButtonStyle.description: The styles available for the tertiary button in a modal.

title: A type that represents a three button modal configuration of a {@link UiSdlModal}.
name: UiSdlThreeButtonModal
